import awkward as ak

from pocket_coffea.lib.weights.weights import WeightData, WeightLambda


class ToyReweight(WeightLambda):
    name = "toy_reweight"
    has_variations = True

    @staticmethod
    def _function(params, metadata, events, size, shape_variation):
        raw_weight = events.LHEWeight_originalXWGTUP
        nominal = raw_weight / ak.mean(raw_weight)
        up = nominal * 1.05
        down = nominal * 0.95
        return WeightData(name="toy_reweight", nominal=nominal, up=up, down=down)
